package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"reflect"
)

// A pointer to an interface variable crosses as a pointer to the interface,
// whatever the variable holds: nil, or a boxed value.

type S struct{ V any }

func main() {
	pi := new(interface{})
	v := reflect.ValueOf(pi).Elem()
	fmt.Println(v.Kind(), v.IsNil(), reflect.TypeOf(pi))
	*pi = 3
	fmt.Println(reflect.ValueOf(pi).Elem().Kind(), reflect.ValueOf(pi).Elem().Elem().Kind(), *pi)

	var x any = ""
	fmt.Println(reflect.ValueOf(&x).Elem().IsNil(), reflect.ValueOf(x).Kind(), reflect.TypeOf(&x))
	var y any
	fmt.Println(reflect.ValueOf(&y).Elem().IsNil())

	// Positive control: interface fields and elements already crossed as
	// interface values.
	s := S{}
	fmt.Println(reflect.ValueOf(&s).Elem().Field(0).IsNil())
	s.V = ""
	fmt.Println(reflect.ValueOf(&s).Elem().Field(0).IsNil())
	arr := make([]any, 2)
	arr[1] = ""
	fmt.Println(reflect.ValueOf(arr).Index(0).IsNil(), reflect.ValueOf(arr).Index(1).IsNil())
	os.Exit(3)
}
